suites.tagZh: 画师 / 摄影 / 美术
suites.platformNoteZh: 全平台（视觉引擎在 macOS 默认走 Apple Vision，其他系统可切经典特征）
suites.platformNoteEn: Cross-platform (Apple Vision on macOS, Classic engine elsewhere)
suites.descZh: 面向画师与摄影师的离线看图与灵感工作台：随机洗牌与色彩光谱漫游、暗房级逐像素精审与多图卷帘对比，内置直方图、EXIF 与 AI 生成参数检索。
suites.descEn: Offline visual review studio for artists and photographers: seeded shuffle and color-spectrum browsing, darkroom loupe with synced 2–4 image wipe comparison, plus histograms, EXIF, and AI prompt search.

presets.titleZh: 画室精审 · 漫游、审计与看图
presets.descZh: 灵感漫游墙配色彩审计与相似灵感侧栏，专注选片、看图与构图比对。
presets.descEn: Creative Browse wall paired with Color Audit and Similar Inspiration sidebars for focused visual review.

presets.titleZh: 创作者全套 · 精审 + 搜图 + 识字抠图
presets.descZh: 在画室精审基础上同时启用以图搜图、实况文本 OCR 与一键主体抠图。
presets.descEn: Adds reverse/text visual search, Live Text OCR, and one-click transparent cutouts to the full Atelier desk.

suites.platformNoteZh: 全平台（macOS 开箱可用 Apple Vision；文搜图需导入 Chinese-CLIP 运行包）
suites.platformNoteEn: Cross-platform (Apple Vision on macOS; Chinese-CLIP runtime enables text-to-image)
suites.descZh: 把以图搜图、中英文自然语言文搜图、视觉去重、实况文本 OCR 与一键透明抠图合在一套，按需挂载或热切换本地视觉引擎。
suites.descEn: Unites reverse image search, bilingual text-to-image search, visual deduplication, Live Text OCR, and one-click subject cutouts with hot-swappable local vision engines.

presets.titleZh: 灵图检索 · 以图/文搜图与去重
presets.descZh: 以图搜图、外图拖入直搜、相似灵感侧栏与重复连拍清理；配 Chinese-CLIP 运行包可开启中英文文搜图。
presets.descEn: Reverse image search, drag-to-search without importing, similar-item sidebar, and duplicate cleanup; add the Chinese-CLIP runtime for text search.

presets.titleZh: 灵眸视觉 · 实况 OCR 与一键抠图
presets.titleEn: Vision Studio · Live Text OCR & Cutout
presets.descZh: 识别图片文字写入全局搜索、支持直接划选复制，一键抠出透明主体并无损导出。
presets.descEn: Index and copy text directly from images, and lift clean transparent subjects for collage or export.

presets.titleZh: 视觉全能台 · 搜图 + 识字 + 抠图
presets.titleEn: Full Vision Desk · Search + OCR + Cutout
presets.descZh: 同时开启视觉检索、实况 OCR、一键抠图与灵感参考板，一套覆盖全部看图需求。
presets.descEn: Enables visual search, Live Text OCR, cutouts, and PureBoard together in one workspace.

suites.descZh: 面向品牌与视觉设计的资产工作台：字体试打墙与可变轴、PSD/PSB 图层审稿、SVG 图标调色、3D 模型展台与灵感参考板。
suites.descEn: Visual design asset desk featuring a live type specimen wall, local PSD/PSB layer inspection, safe SVG recoloring, WebGL2 3D turntable, and PureBoard.

presets.titleZh: 综合设计资产库
presets.descZh: 统一管理字体、PSD、SVG、3D 模型与图片参考，按选中类型自动切换工具栏。
presets.descEn: Organize fonts, PSDs, SVGs, 3D models, and references with context-aware inspector tools.

presets.titleZh: 字体馆 · 试打瀑布流
presets.descZh: 直接进入全局同步试打墙，调节字号字距与可变轴，并排比对多款字体。
presets.descEn: Open directly into the synchronized type wall with variable axes, specimen views, and side-by-side comparison.

presets.titleZh: 设计台账 · 规格检索
presets.descZh: 以表格核对字体授权、PSD 尺寸 DPI、SVG 颜色与 3D 面数。
presets.descEn: Audit font licenses, PSD dimensions, SVG palettes, and 3D poly counts row by row.

suites.tagZh: 电子书 / 漫画 / 书摘
suites.descZh: 一站式个人藏书与精读空间：支持 EPUB、Kindle、PDF、漫画画集与长篇 TXT，配备实体书架、书目台账与书摘回跳。
suites.descEn: Personal reading room for EPUB, Kindle, PDF, comics, and long TXT files — with a tactile bookshelf, book catalog table, and highlights that jump back to the exact passage.

presets.titleZh: 青瓷书房 · 书架模式
presets.descZh: 按书架陈列多格式藏书与阅读进度，随阅读自动切出章节目录与批注。
presets.descEn: Browse your multi-format library on a bookshelf with reading progress and contextual table of contents.

presets.titleZh: 书目台账 · 编目模式
presets.descZh: 按作者、丛书、出版年、ISBN 与阅读状态批量校对，附年度书墙。
presets.descEn: Curate authors, series, years, ISBNs, and reading status in a table alongside the Year Wall.

presets.titleZh: 精读与书摘工作台
presets.descZh: 以书摘馆与每日回顾为核心，所有摘录均可一键跳回原书高亮位置。
presets.descEn: Centers on the Highlights Hub and daily review, with one-click jump back to the source passage.

suites.tagZh: 拉片 / 黑胶 / 听译 / 快剪
suites.platformNoteZh: 全平台（离线语音听译需导入 Whisper 运行包）
suites.platformNoteEn: Cross-platform (offline transcription requires the Whisper runtime)
suites.descZh: 将放映室、黑胶台、离线语音听译与视频无损快剪合为一套：逐帧拉片、黑胶听音、搜台词直达原声与自动分镜剪辑按预设切换。
suites.descEn: Combines Cine Room, Vinyl Deck, offline Whisper transcription, and lossless clip cutting — switch presets between film study, Hi-Fi listening, subtitle search, and storyboard trimming.

presets.titleZh: 黑胶放映室 · 综合影音
presets.descZh: 自适应唱片与影院墙，支持悬停预览、内封多语字幕与真实音频波形。
presets.descEn: Adaptive vinyl and cinema wall with hover scrubbing, embedded multilingual subtitles, and real audio waveforms.

presets.titleZh: 黑胶唱片馆 · 音乐专注
presets.descZh: 按专辑陈列 1:1 唱片封套，配黑胶唱盘、滚动歌词与 10 段均衡器。
presets.descEn: Album-grouped vinyl wall with turntable deck, synced lyrics, and 10-band EQ.

presets.titleZh: 离线听译与台词检索
presets.descZh: 按需用本地 Whisper 生成时间码字幕并接入全局搜索，支持导出 SRT/VTT 与笔记。
presets.descEn: Transcribe audio and video locally on demand with searchable cues and SRT/VTT/Markdown export.

presets.titleZh: 拉片分镜与无损快剪
presets.descZh: 16:9 影院墙配无损秒切、自动镜头分镜拆解与高清故事板，支持不入库直出。
presets.descEn: Widescreen film wall with lossless trimming, automatic scene detection, and HD storyboards.

suites.tagZh: Office / PDF / 压缩包 / 表格
suites.platformNoteZh: 全平台（其中 PDF 手术台依赖 macOS 原生 PDFKit）
suites.descZh: 面向日常文档、数据表与归档包的全离线工作台：直读 Word/PPT/RTF 与全文检索、PDF 合并拆分水印、压缩包免解压检索以及十万行表格分析。
suites.descEn: Offline desk for office files, spreadsheets, and archives: Word/PPT/RTF reading and full-text search, PDF surgery, no-extract archive peeking, and 100k-row data tables.

presets.titleZh: 文档精读与全文检索
presets.descZh: 阅读 DOCX、PPTX、RTF 与 PDF，正文与演讲者备注自动进入全局全文搜索。
presets.descEn: Read Word, PowerPoint, RTF, and PDF with automatic full-text indexing of body text and speaker notes.

presets.titleZh: PDF 手术与批量加工
presets.descZh: 合并、重排、拆分、中文矢量水印与高清转图，支持入库或直接导出到本地。
presets.descEn: Merge, reorder, split, watermark, and render PDFs — save to the library or export straight to disk.

presets.titleZh: 压缩包透视与表格分析
presets.descZh: 免解压直搜 ZIP/TAR 内部文件并按需提取，内置 CSV/XLSX/JSON 虚拟表格与图表。
presets.descEn: Search and extract files inside ZIP/TAR without unpacking, plus fast CSV/XLSX/JSON tables and charts.

suites.tagZh: 批转 / 联系表 / 切图
suites.descZh: 离线批量加工三件套：图片与音视频格式转换压制、长图拼接与暗房联系表/PDF 画册、九宫格切图与游戏精灵图合图，均支持不入库直出。
suites.descEn: Offline batch production trio: image/media format conversion, long-image stitching and contact sheets/PDF albums, and grid slicing/sprite sheets — all with direct-to-disk export.

presets.titleZh: 效率魔方 · 批转、画册与切图
presets.descZh: 轻量直达三大批处理工坊，适合高频转码、出联系表与切图交付。
presets.descEn: Streamlined workspace for fast format conversion, contact sheets, and sprite slicing.

presets.titleZh: 制作全能台 · 批转 + 审计 + 精审
presets.descZh: 叠加图形审计、画师精审与 PSD/SVG 工坊，打通质检到批量交付全流程。
presets.descEn: Adds Image Audit, Loupe Viewer, PSD, and SVG tools for end-to-end QA and delivery.

suites.tagZh: 关系星图 / 空间体检
suites.descZh: 看清大型仓库的脉络与冗余：用交互式关系星图梳理双链、标签与相似素材，用空间树图排查大文件、精确重复项与孤岛资产。
suites.descEn: Map and maintain large libraries with an interactive relation graph across links, tags, and similarity, paired with treemap storage analysis and exact duplicate cleanup.

presets.titleZh: 星图与体检 · 轻量版
presets.descZh: 不依赖视觉模型，启用全局与局部关系星图、空间树图及重复项体检。
presets.descEn: Lightweight graph, treemap storage breakdown, and duplicate hygiene without vision models.

presets.titleZh: 全维星图 · 含视觉相似连线
presets.descZh: 联动灵图检索，在关系星图中叠加视觉相似灵感连线。
presets.descEn: Links Visual Search to overlay visual-similarity edges inside the relation graph.

runtimes.nameZh: Chinese-CLIP 中文语义视觉运行包
runtimes.summaryZh: 内置量化 ONNX 模型与原生推理程序，导入一次即可在多个仓库离线开启中英文自然语言文搜图，无需配置 Python。
runtimes.summaryEn: Self-contained quantized ONNX weights and native runner for offline Chinese/English text-to-image search across libraries — zero Python setup.

runtimes.nameZh: Whisper 离线语音听译运行包
runtimes.summaryZh: 内置 Metal 加速 whisper.cpp 与多语种量化模型，离线把本地音视频转成带时间码的可检索字幕，数据不出本机。
runtimes.summaryEn: Metal-accelerated whisper.cpp with quantized multilingual weights for fully offline timestamped speech transcription.

themes.descZh: 和纸与朱绯纸垂的午后神社白昼，翻面即入微芒渐染的暗夜结界；附定制图标与细腻背景纹理。
themes.descEn: Warm washi paper and vermilion accents by day, deep twilight shrine tones by night — complete with custom icons and subtle textures.

plugins.descZh: 以随机种子洗牌、色彩光谱长河、视觉相似度串联与画幅节奏重新浏览图库，适合找灵感与挑片。
plugins.descEn: Explore image libraries via seeded shuffle, color spectrum rivers, similarity chains, and aspect-ratio rhythm.

plugins.descZh: 查看 RGB/明度直方图、极坐标色盘、像素吸管、贴图对齐质检、相机 EXIF，并自动索引 AI 生图参数。
plugins.descEn: Inspect histograms, polar color wheels, pixel values, texture alignment, camera EXIF, and indexed AI generation prompts.

plugins.titleZh: 画师精审看图与对比台
plugins.descZh: 暗房级看图与选片台：像素网格、镜像灰度、构图参考线、2–4 图同步卷帘对比与速写定时轮播。
plugins.descEn: Darkroom loupe with pixel grid, mirror/grayscale checks, composition guides, synced 2–4 image wipe compare, and timed gesture practice.

plugins.descZh: 无限画布参考板：自由摆放、旋转裁切、吸色便签、紧凑排布，并可撕出为无框置顶小窗。
plugins.descEn: Infinite reference canvas with rotation, cropping, eyedropper, notes, auto-packing, and frameless always-on-top floating windows.

plugins.descZh: 实况文本 OCR 与一键透明主体抠图工作台：图片文字直接入全局搜索与划选复制，抠图原分辨率导出。
plugins.descEn: Live Text OCR and one-click subject cutout desk: search and copy text inside images and export full-resolution transparent PNGs.

plugins.descZh: 离线以图搜图、中英文自然语言文搜图、外图拖入不入库直搜、相似灵感侧栏与三档视觉去重清理。
plugins.descEn: Offline reverse image search, bilingual text-to-image search, zero-ingest drag search, similar-item sidebar, and visual deduplication.

plugins.descZh: 支持 TTF/OTF/WOFF/WOFF2 试打墙、可变轴调节、字形表、同屏叠影比对与商用授权记录。
plugins.descEn: Type specimen wall for TTF/OTF/WOFF/WOFF2 with variable axes, glyph tables, overlay comparison, and license notes.

plugins.descZh: 无需 Photoshop 直读 PSD/PSB 图层树与规格，支持图层显隐合成、孤立检视与原分辨率单层导出。
plugins.descEn: Inspect PSD/PSB layer trees locally without Photoshop, toggle visibility, isolate layers, and export full-res PNGs.

plugins.descZh: 安全预览 SVG 矢量图形、线框与多尺寸检查、无损换色、源码精简，并一键复制 React/CSS 或转 PNG。
plugins.descEn: Safe SVG inspection with wireframe and multi-size previews, live recoloring, minification, and React/CSS/PNG export.

plugins.descZh: 本地预览 GLB/glTF/STL/OBJ 模型并自动生成棚拍缩略图，提供棚拍/黏土/法线/线框着色与置顶展台。
plugins.descEn: Preview GLB, glTF, STL, and OBJ models with automatic studio thumbnails, four shading modes, and a floating turntable.

plugins.descZh: 双页对开与纸张排版 EPUB 精读器，支持护眼主题、脚注浮层、插图灯箱、全书搜索与书摘导出。
plugins.descEn: Paginated and two-page EPUB reader with paper themes, footnote popovers, image lightbox, full-book search, and note export.

plugins.descZh: 离线精读 MOBI/AZW3/KF8、FB2、DOCX 与 MHTML 长文，支持双页对开、全书搜索与语音朗读。
plugins.descEn: Read MOBI, AZW3, KF8, FB2, DOCX, and MHTML offline with spread layout, full-text search, and read-aloud.

plugins.descZh: 自动识别编码并切分长篇小说章节，支持双页阅读、目录导航、全书搜索与批注书签。
plugins.descEn: Auto-detects text encodings and splits chapters for long novels with spread pagination, search, and bookmarks.

plugins.descZh: 直读 CBZ/CBT/CBR 归档与多图画集，支持日漫右翻双页对开、条漫长卷与单页收藏入库。
plugins.descEn: Read CBZ, CBT, CBR, and image sets in single-page, RTL manga spread, or vertical strip modes with single-page capture.

plugins.descZh: 拟真书架浏览布局与书房主页，按状态、作者或丛书陈列藏书，追踪阅读进度与每日书摘。
plugins.descEn: Tactile bookshelf layout and study home organizing books by status, author, or series alongside reading progress.

plugins.descZh: 为电子书、PDF 与漫画建立统一书目字段，追踪阅读状态、时长与年度书墙统计。
plugins.descEn: Unified book catalog fields across ebooks, PDFs, and comics with reading status, time tracking, and a Year Wall.

plugins.descZh: 汇聚全库读书摘录，支持按书归档、每日翻牌回顾、高清书摘卡片生成与一键跳回原文。
plugins.descEn: Collects all reading excerpts with daily flashcard review, shareable quote cards, and one-click jump back to source.

plugins.descZh: 面向拉片与审片的专业播放器：逐帧步进、A-B 循环、内封多语字幕直切、分镜标记与双视频卷帘对比。
plugins.descEn: Film-study video player with frame stepping, A-B loop, embedded multilingual subtitles, shot markers, and dual-video wipe compare.

plugins.descZh: 高解析音乐与播客播放器：黑胶唱盘、真实音频波形、双语滚动歌词、10 段均衡器与时间戳书签。
plugins.descEn: Hi-Fi music and podcast player with turntable animation, real waveforms, synced lyrics, 10-band EQ, and audio bookmarks.

plugins.descZh: 1:1 黑胶封套与 16:9 影院画幅自适应浏览布局，支持视频悬停预览、自动专辑聚合与续播入口。
plugins.descEn: Adaptive 1:1 vinyl and 16:9 cinema browsing wall with hover video scrubbing, album grouping, and resume cards.

plugins.descZh: 按需离线转写音视频对白，字幕全文自动入全局搜索，点词直达对应播放位置并支持导出 SRT/VTT/笔记。
plugins.descEn: On-demand offline speech transcription with searchable global cues, click-to-seek playback, and SRT/VTT/Markdown export.

plugins.descZh: 时间轴快速设定入出点无损秒切，支持自动镜头分镜拆解与高清故事板，可入库或直接导出到本地。
plugins.descEn: Lossless timeline trimming, automatic scene breakdown, and HD storyboards — save to your library or export straight to disk.

plugins.descZh: 离线阅读 Word (.docx)、PowerPoint (.pptx) 与中文 RTF，正文与演讲者备注自动入全文搜索，支持转 Markdown 与直出。
plugins.descEn: Read DOCX, PPTX (with speaker notes), and Chinese RTF offline with automatic full-text search, Markdown capture, and direct export.

plugins.descZh: 合并、重排旋转、精准拆分、矢量中文水印、高清转图、多图合 PDF 与大纲文本提取，支持不入库直出。
plugins.descEn: Merge, reorder, rotate, split, watermark, render, and extract text from PDFs using macOS PDFKit — with library or direct export.

plugins.descZh: 不解压直接浏览和全文搜索 ZIP/TAR/TAR.GZ 内部文件，即时预览图文并按需提取入库或导出到本地。
plugins.descEn: Browse and search inside ZIP, TAR, and TAR.GZ archives without unpacking, preview contents, and extract selectively.

plugins.descZh: 流畅浏览十万行 CSV/TSV/XLSX/JSON 数据，提供列分布统计、筛选排序、交互图表生成与多格式互转。
plugins.descEn: Explore 100k-row CSV, TSV, XLSX, and JSON files with column histograms, filtering, interactive charts, and format export.

plugins.descZh: 批量压图、WebP/JPEG/PNG/ICO 转换、贴图对齐、水印与音视频转码抽帧，支持入库或直接导出到本地。
plugins.descEn: Batch image compression, format conversion, watermarks, and FFmpeg video/audio transcoding with library or direct export.

plugins.descZh: 无缝拼接长图、生成暗房编号联系表（含 EXIF 标注）与多页 PDF 画册，支持入库或直接导出到本地。
plugins.descEn: Stitch long images, build numbered darkroom contact sheets with EXIF labels, and assemble multi-page PDF albums.

plugins.descZh: 九宫格/自定义网格批量切图、自动跳过空瓦片，以及游戏 Sprite Sheet 合图与动画预览，支持不入库直出。
plugins.descEn: Slice grids with empty-tile skipping and pack game sprite sheets with animation preview and TexturePacker/CSS coordinates.

plugins.descZh: 汇聚双链引用、批注、分组、标签与视觉相似关系，以交互力导向星图与局部侧栏检出关联和孤岛素材。
plugins.descEn: Interactive force-directed graph uniting links, annotations, folders, tags, and visual similarity, with local sidebar and orphan detection.

plugins.descZh: 用矩形树图分析空间占用，精确排查重复文件、加工失败项与孤立批注，并一键压缩回收数据库空间。
plugins.descEn: Treemap storage analyzer with exact duplicate detection, failed-task retry, orphan diagnostics, and SQLite compaction.

plugins.descZh: 把保存的视图变成随手置顶收纳盒，拖入或粘贴素材时自动按视图规则打标归位。
plugins.descEn: Turn any saved view into a floating drop box that automatically tags and files dragged or pasted items.

plugins.titleZh: Apple Vision 视觉特征引擎
plugins.descZh: 调用 macOS 系统神经引擎离线提取 768 维视觉特征，开箱为灵图检索与创意漫游提供以图搜图能力。
plugins.descEn: Uses macOS Vision framework locally for zero-setup 768D visual embeddings powering reverse image search and similarity browsing.

plugins.descZh: 纯 TypeScript 跨平台视觉特征引擎，无需原生模型即可在 Windows、Linux 与 macOS 上提供以图搜图与视觉去重。
plugins.descEn: Pure TypeScript cross-platform visual feature engine enabling similarity search and deduplication with zero native dependencies.

plugins.descZh: 搭配 huoye-cn-clip 共享运行包，为灵图检索提供离线中英双语自然语言文搜图与图文混搜能力。
plugins.descEn: Pairs with the huoye-cn-clip shared runtime to power offline Chinese & English text-to-image and cross-modal search.

plugins.titleZh: Apple Vision 识字抠图引擎
plugins.descZh: 调用 macOS 原生 Vision 框架离线执行高精度多语 OCR 与前景主体抠图，为灵眸视觉供能。
plugins.descEn: Uses macOS Vision locally for high-accuracy multilingual OCR and foreground subject cutouts in Vision Studio.

plugins.titleZh: Tesseract 跨平台 OCR 引擎
plugins.descZh: 对接本机 Tesseract 的跨平台文字识别引擎，在 Windows、Linux 与 macOS 上为灵眸视觉提供多语 OCR。
plugins.descEn: Cross-platform OCR capability provider backed by local Tesseract for Vision Studio on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

plugins.descZh: 搭配 huoye-whisper 共享运行包，为听译字幕工坊提供离线多语种语音转写与时间戳能力。
plugins.descEn: Pairs with the huoye-whisper shared runtime to provide offline multilingual speech-to-text for Whisper Subtitle Studio.
